meta.title: feat!: simplify tracing by removing S3 push/pull and using atomic file writes
meta.body_summary: Backport tracer refactor replacing S3 push/pull and buffered file with atomic channel-based cached file writes, removing ~934 lines and simplifying tracing to local file output.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot refactor replacing S3 push/pull with channel-based cached file; maintainer requested linter fix and design simplifications; PR closed due to low priority.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1123 changed lines, this is a medium-to-large refactor by absolute volume (mostly deletions). As a simplification perf PR it was closed—not merged—due to low priority despite functional acceptance.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer evan-forbes requested three levels of simplification: first fix linter, then remove intermediate buffer in flush, then further remove chunkSize, buffer, and flush method entirely, writing directly from channel.
review_details.performance_claim: Simplified tracing replaces S3 push/pull and buffered files with channel-based atomic file writes for reliability and performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer labeled low priority and stated 'debating even working on this atm'; PR left open and eventually closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Even with functional correctness, Copilot PRs can be left unmerged if maintainers deem the task low priority, despite an otherwise technically valid refactor.

detection_detail.code_reading: evan-forbes reviewed cached_file.go extensively, requesting simplifications to the write path and caching logic.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Linting CI runs revealed gofmt issues, which Copilot fixed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or performance data provided; the PR focuses on architectural simplification, and maintainer tested manually (comment 'this works').
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer ultimately closed/ignored the PR due to low priority; no revert or fix cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Simplified tracing by removing S3 push/pull, HTTP server, and buffered file; introduced channel-based cachedFile with atomic writes and direct file writing. Also added deprecation notices for old config, updated tests, and removed legacy test files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Fileserver and buffered_file are removed; config files updated with deprecation comments; decoder.go changed ReadString to ReadBytes for performance; new test cached_file_test.go added.
change_trajectory: Implement tracer refactor: replace buffered files with cached files, remove S3/HTTP functionality.
Fix gofmt linting issues per review.
Simplify flush method by removing intermediate buffer allocation.
Further simplify by removing chunkSize, buffer, and flush method entirely; write events directly from channel.

review_signals.summary: Requested gofmt linting fixes; otherwise LGTM.
Suggested removing intermediate buffer allocation and flush method to simplify cached file writes.
Requested removal of chunkSize, buffer, and flush method; write directly from channel.
Simplified implementation by removing chunkSize, buffer, and flush method.
Acknowledged PR works, but is low priority; debating continuing work.
review_signals.action_taken: PR remained open and eventually closed.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR linked to issue with tracer refactor (6 commits, 1123 lines changed).
Maintainer evan-forbes immediately requested linter fix and later design simplifications over three rounds of inline review.
Copilot iterated on formatting and caching logic, eventually removing chunkSize, buffer, and flush method per review.
After all changes, evan-forbes labeled PR low priority and commented it works but is low priority; no further action taken, leading to eventual close.
